newsitem.title: USA: U.S. investigates new Israeli settlement report.
newsitem.headline: U.S. investigates new Israeli settlement report.

text.p: The United States said on Tuesday it was investigating reports that Israel plans to expand a Jewish settlement in the occupied West Bank and continued to believe settlements complicate the peace process.

Shmuel Lanza, local council head in the Emmanuel settlement, said on Monday that Israeli Defence Minister Yitzhak Mordechai had approved plans for a huge expansion of the settlement. The Defence Ministry declined comment.

"We're looking into these reports to find out what we can about it. I'm not certain that the Israeli government has in fact made any kind of an announcement about this," State Department spokesman Glyn Davies said.

"But our standpoint on this type of activity is clear that such settlement work, or new settlement work, is not at all helpful to the negotiating process," he said, referring to Israeli-Palestinian talks on Palestinian self-rule.
"Israeli settlements complicate the negotiating process that's now underway and create tension in the region," Davies added.
